scope: Same-host TCP. All native cells run five times; every sample retained. Diagnostic captures use separate short budgets and never enter timing results.
goal: portable mean and pooled p50 < fixed C++ independently, and positive reads/writes plus attempts <= C++ independently per process capture.
statistics: mean_ns is the pooled arithmetic mean; displayed ± run SD is sample SD (n-1) across five run means, not a confidence interval. Sample SD and extrema are retained separately.

branch_simulation.scope: Complete-process Callgrind cache/branch simulation; startup, warmup and teardown included. Not hardware counters or native timings. L1 I/D 32 KiB, 64-byte lines, 8-way; LL 256 MiB direct mapped. Hardware branch-miss perf_event_open was denied with EPERM.

dispatch_costs.scope: Self events in the maintenance poll plus any outlined idle-walk/accounting helper, excluding ownership-bearing maintenance_step and other callees. Complete-process diagnostics; helper costs are not omitted.

cpu_diagnostics.scope: Five separate instrumented process runs, complete variant rotation. Read-to-next-write thread CPU gaps on the same fd/thread include intervening application/protocol work and probe overhead, including startup/warmup/teardown. Not isolated decoder/writer latency; no values enter the native speed gate. candidate denotes the unfactored walk.

archive.count_scope: Logical bytes including hard links, excluding SHA256SUMS itself.

parent_hosted.scope: Separate two-host hosted baseline campaign, not candidate qualification; complete artifact retained as ZIP.
